attchmntText: Vikas EcoTech Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Vikas Ecotech Limited board approved standalone and consolidated unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The company reported a profit of 52.54 lakh rupees for the quarter and 56.14 lakh rupees for the half year. Paid-up equity share capital stands at 13,883.56 lakh rupees. The company proposed a reduction in share capital by cancelling 38,03,50,000 equity shares and cancelling securities premium of 121.71 crore rupees. This reduction is subject to requisite statutory and regulatory approvals. Approvals from the National Stock Exchange, BSE Limited, and the National Company Law Tribunal are awaited. The Directorate of Enforcement issued a provisional attachment order against assets of a promoter in his individual capacity. The company states these proceedings are not directed against it and are not expected to have a material adverse impact. The company also received income tax demand notices aggregating to 17.71 crore rupees. The company intends to contest these demands and has not recognized any provision.
